title: viburnum plicatum f. lanceatum
intro: Viburnum plicatum f. lanceatum, commonly known as the Korean Spice Viburnum, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, characterized by its showy, lacy white flowers and red berries. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum plicatum f. lanceatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as linalool and geraniol, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
